name: Pocket Expenses - Bank SMS Auto-Tracking Knowledge Graph
description: Knowledge graph tracking the architecture, components, flows, and Android native bridge for auto-tracking expenses from bank SMS messages.

communities.name: Mobile UI & Review Flow
communities.description: Components and pages delivering the user interface on Android APK.

communities.name: SMS Engine & Parsing
communities.description: Bilingual (AR/EN) SMS normalization, amount/currency extraction, and category categorization.

communities.name: Android Native & Capacitor Bridge
communities.description: Android permissions, Telephony BroadcastReceiver, and Capacitor plugin.

communities.name: Data Models & Storage
communities.description: Supabase database operations, domain types, and data hooks.

nodes.label: Mobile Page
nodes.description: Primary mobile view for standalone APK. Listens to incoming SMS, fetches background queued SMS, shows alerts, and manages expenses.

nodes.label: BankSmsTrackerModal
nodes.description: Modal interface for reviewing pending bank transactions, scanning device inbox, toggling auto-save vs review, and testing SMS parser.

nodes.label: SMS Parser Engine
nodes.description: Parses English and Arabic bank SMS. Normalizes numerals, extracts amounts, currencies, merchants, dates, and matches categories.

nodes.label: Bank SMS Bridge
nodes.description: TypeScript client bridge to Capacitor BankSms plugin, managing user preferences, deduplication storage, and background queues.

nodes.label: SMS Parser Tests
nodes.description: Automated node:test suite verifying bank SMS formats (Etihad, Arab Bank, Manaseer, CliQ, OTP filtering).

nodes.label: AndroidManifest.xml
nodes.description: Declares RECEIVE_SMS and READ_SMS permissions and registers SmsBroadcastReceiver.

nodes.label: SmsBroadcastReceiver
nodes.description: Listens for Telephony.SMS_RECEIVED broadcast. Persists unhandled messages in SharedPreferences and notifies plugin.

nodes.label: BankSmsPlugin
nodes.description: Capacitor Plugin handling permission requests, content://sms/inbox scanning, and dispatching real-time smsReceived events.

nodes.label: MainActivity
nodes.description: Native Android entrypoint registering BankSmsPlugin with the Capacitor bridge.

nodes.label: useExpenses Hook
nodes.description: Data management hook querying and inserting expenses into Supabase with account_type bank.

nodes.label: useCategories Hook
nodes.description: Fetches household categories used for category auto-detection in SMS transactions.

nodes.label: Domain Types
nodes.description: Core TypeScript interfaces: Expense, ExpenseFormData, Category, Visibility, AccountType.

nodes.label: Build APK Script
nodes.description: Builds, signs, and outputs pocket-expenses.apk into artifacts/ directory.
